_comment: Third parties Bailey may ASK questions of. NOT principals. Being listed here grants NO inbound authority: these addresses stay off EMAIL_ALLOWED_USERS, so a message from them is never dispatched to the agent. Listing here does two things only: (1) principals are force-copied and Reply-To is set on any send to this address, (2) if they reply without a principal on the thread, the principals get a notice instead of the message being dropped silently. Fail-closed: a malformed or missing file means no correspondents.

correspondents.name: Eric Ross
correspondents.may_be_asked: What a line item or charge on a CRT owner statement is for, and which property or unit a charge belongs to.
correspondents.may_not_be: Told what will be entered in the books, asked to approve anything, or given any instruction. Matt and Amy decide; Bailey asks.
